cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Whose coat needed the second cup of tea while I was out?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. True. Who was keeping that one warm from the inside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still on the cup. Did its owner take sugar?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 whose coat and A3 who inside the coat directly seek identity despite a circumlocution; status mostly appears in prefixed claims rather than organizing an actual indirect inquiry.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 answers B2 coat correction by naming its wearer; A5 returns to sugar after B4 names the visitor question.

relationship.evidence: B2 corrects an odd literal premise and B4 identifies the evasion, plausible but mostly reacting to strained phrasing.

heightening.evidence: A5 retreats from A3 direct identity question to preference, without cleanly sustaining never naming the sought fact.

specificity.evidence: A1 coat and second cup suggest a visitor; the coat-drinking formulation is unnecessarily artificial.
